blocks.title: Responsible data sharing
blocks.text: Zimmedarana data sharing ka matlab zaati ya hassas maloomat sirf zaroorat par aur sirf bharosemand fareeqon se share karna hai.
Online scholarship ki darkhwast mein students ko zaati tafseel sirf mehfooz, tasdeeq shuda websites par dalni chahiye ta ke ghalat istemal na ho.

blocks.prompt: Zimmedarana data sharing maloomat ke akhlaqi istemal mein kaise madad deti hai (short question 7)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sirf zaroori maloomat, sirf zaroorat mand ko, mehfooz raaston se share kar ke logon ki privacy ka ehtaram karti hai, jis se shanakht ki chori, dhoke aur ghalat istemal ka khatra kam hota aur data walon ka bharosa qaim rehta hai.

items: Zaati data sirf zaroorat par, sirf bharosemand aur mehfooz fareeqon se share karein.
